_about: Ceilings for what OA-4 says Nano's Linux-compiled shared code must not hold (docs/linux/DECISIONS.md
OA-4, docs/linux/ARCHITECTURE-AUDIT.md migration step 0, IMPLEMENTATION.md H.4). Counted by
(less the feature-switch files, off on Linux) and the top-level nano/*.h and *.inc; never platform/**.
Each ceiling may only shrink, towards 0. tools/nano-tree/tests/test_linux_ratchets.py fails when a
count goes over its ceiling (move the new code behind nanoplat instead) and when it drops under it
(lower the ceiling: py -3.12 tools/nano-tree/tests/test_linux_ratchets.py --lower, which never raises one).
